_why: Operator 2026-10-16: "with the self-fixing in some of these procedures, I just don't want the regular LLM routing. I want it to connect into Claude Code to fix it in iterations." A self-heal diagnosis with failure_class code_error becomes ONE fix job per failure signature. scripts/self_heal_fixer.py runs headless Claude Code in an isolated worktree off origin/main, iterates (failing test first -> fix -> targeted tests + run_cio_hardening_ci.py --profile pr), and on success opens a PR labelled self-heal-fix. A fix PR is not a heal: the job closes only at incident_resolved (deployed code + recovered output). Design: docs/ops/self_heal_claude_fixer.md.

arming._why: DISARMED by default. --apply needs ALL of: an ACTIVE guard grant of grant_tier whose reason names grant_reason_token (peek only, never consumed: bin/guard grant git-push --for 8h --uses 4 --reason 'self-heal-fixer ...'), and fewer than daily_job_cap jobs started today (ET). The model's output never arms anything. Budget (architect review 2026-10-16, finding 3): every attempt durably RESERVES its whole budget (iteration.max_iterations, max_cost_usd, max_minutes) in the claims db before the backend is launched; daily_job_cap and daily_cost_cap_usd are checked against reservations, so a crash can never let the day overspend and an interrupted attempt is counted exactly once.

selector._why: STATIC. The adaptive router (lib/self_heal_fixer.shadow_route over repair memory) runs in SHADOW only: its recommendation is recorded on each job and in repair memory, never used to choose.

backends._why: SelfHealFixBackend@v1: cwd = fix worktree, prompt on stdin, credential-free env, tests only via the sandboxed pytest wrapper. Acceptance is never the backend's claim: scripts/lib/self_heal_fix_evaluator.py judges harness-run tests and CI on the PR head. A backend is selectable only when enabled AND qualified; qualifying one (e.g. codex_cli) = it passes the same acceptance suite (tests/test_self_heal_fixer_20261016.py backend-parametrized scenarios) and a live seeded-defect job judged by the evaluator, then an operator config PR flips qualified. coder-dispatch stays retired (operator hold 2026-10-16); its registry entries are not used.

claude_code.qualified_basis: contract + acceptance suite with a mocked CLI (2026-10-16); first live job is its live qualification

codex_cli.qualified_basis: NOT qualified. Install, verify the argv against the installed codex CLI, run the acceptance suite with backend=codex_cli, one live seeded-defect job, then an operator PR.

policy_gate._why: AGENTS.md 12.0.0 section 24.5 forbids a scheduled job from pushing or opening a PR. Until the operator ratifies the amendment (docs/ops/self_heal_claude_fixer.md section 9) the fixer stops at fix_ready_local: the fix is committed on a local branch and the PR body is written as an artifact. The push/PR step runs only when AGENTS.md at the job's base commit carries this heading marker with the word ACTIVE on the same line.
policy_gate.amendment_heading_marker: ## 24.11 Self-heal fix PRs from the self-heal-fixer lane

claude._why: Headless Claude Code, the same binary coder_dispatch.py's claude_code backend names (config/coder_backends.json). dontAsk denies every tool call not pre-approved below; the harness re-checks the resulting diff anyway (the AGENTS guard hook is not installed for Claude Code, docs/ops/AGENTS_GUARD_HOOK.md). The prompt goes on stdin. --setting-sources project: the user's interactive allow rules (gh pr merge, the deploy script) are not loaded. The model runs tests only through the harness-written pytest wrapper {pytest}, which runs pytest inside the bwrap sandbox below. The child env is built from env_names only: no DB, broker or provider credential reaches the model or its Bash.

auth._why: The ONLY credential inside the agent sandbox (finding 2). The Claude CLI on Linux keeps its OAuth login in ~/.claude/.credentials.json; that one file is bind-mounted at {agent_home}/.claude/.credentials.json and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR points there, so the rest of ~/.claude (history, transcripts, settings, other projects), ~/.claude.json and every other credential stay invisible. rw lets the CLI persist a token refresh in place (a read-only bind could strand a rotated refresh token). The harness never reads or copies this file. mode none = bind nothing (stub CLIs in tests).

sandbox._why: Every HARNESS test run (red-first, targeted, the PR-profile CI) of a candidate runs under bwrap over an allowlist filesystem (lib/self_heal_fixer.eval_sandbox_prefix): a fresh shared clone of the candidate commit, read-only together with its own .git and the borrowed objects; only the scratch state writable; own network namespace; cleared env. A digest of the checkout and its .git is taken before and after every run, so a write is refused even where bwrap is off. enabled=true with bwrap missing fails the job (sandbox_unavailable); it never runs unsandboxed. hide_paths applies only to the legacy host-view sandbox_prefix.

diff_guard._why: A diff matching any refuse pattern is refused by code before anything is committed (AGENTS.md section 0, section 17, section 24.5-24.7). Model text cannot widen this list: the fixer refuses any diff touching this file or its own code.

intake._why: This lane is the CONSUMER of the N8nCodeDefect@v1 contract published by the self-heal diagnoser (scripts/n8n_failure_diagnosis.py code_defect_hook, PR #1828): each diagnosis record's code_defect field in diagnoses_rel and each escalation's fix_path, consumer claude_code_iterative_fix. One job per defect_id (lane + signature + episode); the producer's store is read-only to the consumer and the consumption is recorded in this lane's own state. Evidence: the failed run named by evidence.failed_run_id, from the coordination ledger opened read-only.

agent_sandbox._why: Architect review 2026-10-16, finding 2: the Claude Code process ITSELF runs inside bwrap, not only its tests. Allowlist filesystem (lib/self_heal_fixer.agent_sandbox_prefix): an empty root; read-only system dirs, the repo's .git (history; the operator's working tree with its untracked .env backups is NOT bound), the venv, the CLI binary and the harness bin dir; read-write ONLY on the candidate worktree, a throwaway HOME and the scratch state. $HOME is never bound (.env, .ssh, .config/gh, .cursor, .claude, trade-ai-releases, persistent state invisible). Own network namespace: the only way out is the in-sandbox bridge to the host CONNECT proxy (lib/self_heal_egress.py) that allows egress_allow host:port pairs and nothing else, so the host's Postgres, n8n and command center are unreachable. The model's pytest runs inside this same boundary with a cleared env (nested bwrap is refused on this host by kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns). enabled=false is honoured only with TRADE_AI_CI=1 (hermetic tests); otherwise the job fails agent_sandbox_disabled. Residual risk: docs/ops/self_heal_claude_fixer.md section 6a.

lease._why: Durable claim per defect signature (lib/self_heal_fixer_claims.py, finding 3). The owner renews its lease every heartbeat_s while the backend runs; on start, an active claim whose lease expired (or whose owner pid on this host is dead) becomes fix_interrupted with its recorded partial evidence and is never restarted blindly.
